name: Goldie
editorial_article: Goldie, born Clifford Joseph Price in 1965, is a seminal figure in British electronic music, recognized globally for his pioneering contributions to the jungle and drum and bass genres. Emerging from the West Midlands graffiti and breakdance scenes of the 1980s, Price transitioned into music production in the early 1990s after being introduced to the burgeoning breakbeat scene. His creative philosophy, characterized by an adventurous synthesis of raw urban energy, intricate breakbeat programming, and orchestral arrangements, helped propel jungle and drum and bass from underground club culture to mainstream critical acclaim. \n\nHis 1995 debut album, 'Timeless', is widely regarded as a landmark work that challenged the conventions of electronic music, most notably through its title track—a 21-minute symphony that blended breakbeats with expansive, cinematic textures. Beyond his own discography, Goldie significantly shaped the sonic landscape of the era through his influential label, Metalheadz, which he co-founded in 1994. Metalheadz became a crucible for innovative sound design in the drum and bass scene, fostering artists who pushed the boundaries of tempo and timbre. Throughout his multi-faceted career, Goldie has also maintained a prominent profile as a visual artist, actor, and cultural commentator, consistently merging his background in street art with his experimental approach to sound production, cementing his legacy as a key innovator in modern dance music. His work bridges the gap between the raw, percussive intensity of the hardcore rave scene and the sophisticated, atmospheric soundscapes that define intelligent drum and bass. Through the consistent development of his labels and his collaboration with artists like Diane Charlemagne, Goldie has left an indelible mark on the evolution of British electronic music.
editorial_bio: Goldie is a pioneering UK producer, DJ, and visual artist who played a crucial role in the evolution of jungle and drum and bass throughout the 1990s. He is best known for his landmark album 'Timeless' and his influential record label, Metalheadz.
